question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fame
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disgrace.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Fame" means ****being well-known or celebrated**.(प्रसिद्धि)

 
 
• ​Example: Their fame was short lived.
 
 
 
• **​"Disgrace" means shame or loss of respect.** (अपमान)
 
 
• ​Example: His behavior brought so much disgrace to his family.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the two words are opposite in meaning.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Laurels** means honors or awards, which is similar to Fame but not opposite.(ख्याति)
 
• **Option 3: Glory** means great praise or admiration, which is similar to Fame but not opposite.(वैभव)
 
• **Option 4: Distinction** means excellence or uniqueness, which is similar to Fame but not opposite.(भेद)
